expectations.text: Agency: at least three viable approaches exist (not just board-fight-take)
expectations.evidence: Summary says 'The party must board the Velvet Noose, defeat Mave Sorn, and secure the Magistrate's Warding Chip.' Lines 74-79 explicitly state Mave 'will not surrender the chip through negotiation, persuasion, or deception' and list only combat variants (defeat, flight-capture, incapacitation). The skill accepted the prompt's single-approach constraint instead of opening alternatives.

expectations.text: Causality: Mave's actions follow from her established want (supernatural confirmation to sell)
expectations.evidence: Lines 68-72: Mave wants 'independent confirmation that the Crown's supernatural irregularity is genuine before she files it.' Her current move and next move flow from this want.

expectations.text: Activity: Mave has a concrete next move if uninterrupted
expectations.evidence: Line 101: 'Next move: File her assessment and depart the Strait for a protected harbor. Once ashore, the party's window closes.'

expectations.text: Connectivity: multiple leads point to the intercept from different directions
expectations.evidence: All 4 leads (lines 117-121) point at the same encounter from the same location. They describe different objects (chip, ship, person, place) but not different routes of discovery. No lead reaches the intercept from an unexpected direction.

expectations.text: Gravity: the chip connects to an existing PC interest or campaign thread
expectations.evidence: The chip connects to the Wardstone ritual split, Crown supernatural irregularity, and Dravosi Crown faction — all existing campaign threads.

expectations.text: Persistence: outcomes name lasting world changes
expectations.evidence: Stakes name intelligence market changes, Crown gap, party profile in intel markets, Wardstone split knowledge spreading.

expectations.text: Vault integrity: named entities resolve to existing wiki pages
expectations.evidence: Mave Sorn, Velvet Noose, Magistrate's Warding Chip, Dravosi Crown, Central Strait, Kalowe all resolve to wiki pages.

expectations.text: Quest frame sentence names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
expectations.evidence: Summary (line 26) says 'The party must board... defeat Mave... and secure the chip' — this is a task prescription, not incompatible wants. The 'Why now' paragraph does better but the frame sentence itself fails.

expectations.text: Walk-away entry names what continues without the party
expectations.evidence: Line 86-87: 'Mave Sorn files and sells. The Crown's supernatural irregularity becomes established knowledge among rival powers.'
